'''Lithio Motti''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived at some point during the last centuries of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Lithio was a member of the [[Motti family]] and he [[Marriage/Legends|married]] an heiress from the [[House Praji/Legends|Praji family]], to gain some capital to start a [[Megonite moss/Legends|Megonite moss]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation on [[Phelarion/Legends|Phelarion]]. His descendants continued to control the operation for centuries afterward and one of them, [[Thalassa Tarkin|Thalassa Motti]], married into the [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkin family]].<ref name="TTSP" />
